propositions: Recursive conftest glob in global_support causes all seven mutation shards to be selected for any nested conftest change, wasting runner time across 97 runs (322.6 runner-minutes).
Pytest loads only ancestor conftests for a test directory (root plus five non-root files), never sibling fixture trees like tests/external/live_jira_dc/conftest.py.
Manifest must map each non-root conftest only to shards whose configured tests actually load it, with only tests/conftest.py remaining global support.
Contract must derive per-shard ancestor-conftest closure from configured test paths, fail closed on missing dependencies or stale entries, and pin all pre-existing non-conftest triggers.
Unrelated nested conftest changes must select zero shards; each declared ancestor conftest must select exactly its dependent shards.
All 374 configured shard tests must pass with unchanged results after exact conftest mapping replaces recursive pattern.
